# Vinayapiṭake Vimativinodanī-ṭīkā (Tika Vin07t)

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
The *Vinayapiṭake Vimativinodanī-ṭīkā* (also cataloged as the *Tikā Vimativinodanī*) is a subcommentarial text belonging to the Vinaya subcommentary collection (*Tika-Vinaya*) of the Pali tradition [Clarke, Parājika Penance in Indian Buddhist Monasticisms]. The available reference literature does not analyze its specific doctrinal contents or structure, noting it primarily through the Devanāgarī print edition *Vinayapitake Vimativinodanī-Tīkā Pathamo Bhāgo*, published in the Chaṭṭha Saṅgāyana series by the Vipassana Research Institute in 1998 [Clarke, Parājika Penance in Indian Buddhist Monasticisms].
Computational text-reuse data from DharmaNexus identifies widespread Pali-internal overlap, recording 74,172 matching passages shared across 354 Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. Its most extensive textual relationships are with other Vinaya commentaries and subcommentaries, notably the *Vinayālaṅkāra-ṭīkā* (4,022 matches, sharing up to §2038_0–2066_9 with §846_0–868_9), all three volumes of the *Sāratthadīpanī-ṭīkā* (with over 11,800 matches combined across the three parts), the *Vajirabuddhi-ṭīkā* (4,103 matches), and the *Kaṅkhāvitaraṇīpurāṇa-ṭīkā* (3,538 matches) [DharmaNexus]. Additional substantial reuse is identified with the *Bhikkhupātimokkhapāḷi*, the *Vinayavinicchayaṭīkā*, and the *Pārājikakaṇḍa-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus registers no cross-language matches with a score of 10 or higher [DharmaNexus].

- Text reuse within the Pali corpus (DharmaNexus): Vinayapiṭake Vinayālaṅkāra-ṭīkā (Tika Vin08t) (§2038_0–2066_9 ↔ §846_0–868_9); Vinayapiṭake Sāratthadīpanī-ṭīkā (dutiyo bhāgo) (Tika Vin01t2) (§383_3–384_12 ↔ §204_4–209_0); Vinayapiṭake Sāratthadīpanī-ṭīkā (tatiyo bhāgo) (Tika Vin02t) (§1773_0–1781_2 ↔ §709_2–719_5); Vinayapiṭake Vajirabuddhi-ṭīkā (Tika Vin06t) (§227_1–227_9 ↔ §196_1–196_9); Vinayapiṭake Sāratthadīpanī-ṭīkā (paṭhamo bhāgo) (Tika Vin01t1) (§37_1–40_4 ↔ §133_2–135_5); Vinayapiṭake Kaṅkhāvitaraṇīpurāṇa-ṭīkā (Tika Vin09t) (§944_0–946 ↔ §1168_22–1170); Vinayapiṭake Bhikkhupātimokkhapāḷi (Tika Vin04t) (§383_3–384_12 ↔ §1310_13–1314_8); Vinayapiṭake Vinayavinicchayaṭīkā (Tika Vin11t) (§382_10–384_7 ↔ §223_2–228_3)
